headline: SpaceX's Starship reaches orbit, deploys Starlink satellites despite issues
summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time, deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites during the flight. Coverage varies on how serious the mission's problems were: some describe minor drama or hiccups, while one report says engine trouble cut the planned ten-hour flight short after about three hours.
